questions.title: Coin change ways
questions.text:
Given coin values (unlimited supply of each) and an amount, print the number of ways to make the amount, modulo 1 000 000 007. Order of coins does not matter.

Input: first line n and amount (1 ≤ n ≤ 100, 0 ≤ amount ≤ 10^4); second line n distinct coin values (1 to 10^4).
Output: the number of ways mod 10^9+7.

starterCode.python:
import sys

data = sys.stdin.read().split()
# write your code here

questions.title: Running median
questions.text:
Numbers arrive one by one. After each one, print the median of all numbers so far; for an even count print the smaller of the two middle values.

Input: first line n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5); second line n integers.
Output: n medians separated by spaces.
